eyebrow: Why free-text values quietly break cost allocation
code:
# Without an allowed-values constraint:
cost-center = "platform-team"
cost-center = "Platform Team"
cost-center = "platform_team"

# Three strings, one team — cost reports now
# split that team's real spend across three rows
caption: Requiring a tag exist and constraining its values solve two different problems.
